start_metrics_server: start a Prometheus metrics HTTP server on a given host and port exposing /metrics endpoint
serve_grpc: start the standalone gRPC server with integrated scheduler and optional metrics
enable_func_timer: enable function timer instrumentation for Prometheus metrics collection
set_prometheus_multiproc_dir: set the PROMETHEUS_MULTIPROC_DIR environment variable before prometheus_client imports
cleanup_metrics_runner: clean up the Prometheus metrics HTTP server runner on shutdown
